versos.grego: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν ἐλαιῶν.

controles.web: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
controles.kjv: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
controles.livre: Porém Jesus foi para o monte das Oliveiras.

versos.grego: Ὄρθρου δὲ πάλιν παρεγένετο εἰς τὸ ἱερόν, καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτόν. καὶ καθίσας ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς.

controles.web: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down, and taught them.
controles.kjv: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
controles.livre: E pela manhã cedo voltou ao Templo, e todo o povo veio a ele; e sentando-se, ensinava-os.

versos.grego: ἄγουσι δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς αὐτὸν γυναῖκα ἐν μοιχείᾳ κατειλημμένην, καὶ στήσαντες αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ,

controles.web: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the midst,
controles.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
controles.livre: E trouxeram-lhe os escribas e fariseus uma mulher tomada em adultério;

versos.grego: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ, Διδάσκαλε, αὕτη ἡ γυνὴ κατελήφθη ἐπαυτοφώρῳ μοιχευομένη.

controles.web: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
controles.kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
controles.livre: E pondo-a no meio, disseram-lhe: Mestre, esta mulher foi tomada no momento em que estava adulterando.

versos.grego: ἐν δὲ τῷ νόμῳ Μωσῆς ἡμῖν ἐνετείλατο τὰς τοιαύτας λιθοβολεῖσθαι· σὺ οὖν τί λέγεις;

controles.web: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
controles.kjv: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
controles.livre: E na Lei nos mandou Moisés, que as tais sejam apedrejadas; tu pois que dizes?

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγον πειράζοντες αὐτόν, ἵνα ἔχωσι κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κάτω κύψας, τῷ δακτύλῳ ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν·

controles.web: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of.   But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.
controles.kjv: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
controles.livre: E isto diziam eles, tentando-o, para que tivessem de que o acusar. Mas inclinando-se Jesus, escrevia com o dedo na terra.

versos.grego: ὡς δὲ ἐπέμενον ἐρωτῶντες αὐτόν, ἀνάκυψας εἶπε πρὸς αὐτοὺς, Ὁ ἀναμάρτητος ὑμῶν πρῶτος τὸν λίθον ἐπ’ αὐτῇ βαλέτω.

controles.web: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
controles.kjv: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
controles.livre: E enquanto continuavam lhe perguntando, ele se endireitou, e disse-lhes: Aquele de vós que está sem pecado, seja o primeiro que atire pedra contra ela.

versos.grego: καὶ πάλιν κάτω κύψας ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν.

controles.web: Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
controles.kjv: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
controles.livre: E voltando a se inclinar, escrevia na terra.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ, ἀκούσαντες καὶ ὑπὸ τῆς συνειδήσεως ἐλεγχόμενοι, ἐξήρχοντο εἷς καθεῖς, ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων ἕως τῶν ἐσχάτων· καὶ κατελείφθη μόνος ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἐν μέσῳ ἑστῶσα.

controles.web: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
controles.kjv: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
controles.livre: Porém ouvindo eles isto , e acusados pela própria consciência, saíram um a um, começando dos mais velhos até os últimos; e Jesus ficou só, e a mulher, que estava no meio.

versos.grego: ἀνακύψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ μηδένα θεασάμενος πλὴν τῆς γυναικὸς, εἶπεν αὐτῇ, Ἡ γυνὴ, ποῦ εἰσιν ἐκεῖνοι οἱ κατήγοροί σου; οὐδείς σε κατέκρινεν;

controles.web: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
controles.kjv: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
controles.livre: E endireitando-se Jesus, e não vendo a ninguém além da mulher, disse-lhe: Mulher, onde estão aqueles teus acusadores? Ninguém te condenou?

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν, Οὐδείς, κύριε. εἶπε δὲ αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, Οὐδὲ ἐγώ σε κατακρίνω· πορεύου καὶ μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε.)

controles.web: She said, “No one, Lord.”   Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”
controles.kjv: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
controles.livre: E disse ela: Ninguém, Senhor. E disse-lhe Jesus: Nem eu também te condeno; vai, e não peques mais.»

versos.grego: Πάλιν οὖν αὐτοῖς ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου· ὁ ἀκολουθῶν μοι οὐ μὴ περιπατήσῃ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ, ἀλλ’ ἕξει τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς.

controles.web: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world.He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
controles.kjv: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
controles.livre: Falou-lhes pois Jesus outra vez, dizendo: Eu sou a luz do mundo; quem me seguir não andará em trevas, mas terá luz de vida.

versos.grego: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι Σὺ περὶ σεαυτοῦ μαρτυρεῖς· ἡ μαρτυρία σου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής.

controles.web: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
controles.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe pois os Fariseus: Tu testemunhas de ti mesmo; teu testemunho não é verdadeiro.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Κἂν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία μου, ὅτι οἶδα πόθεν ἦλθον καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγω· ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἔρχομαι ἢ ποῦ ὑπάγω.

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhes: Ainda que eu testemunho de mim mesmo, meu testemunho é verdadeiro; porque sei de onde vim, e para onde vou; porém vós não sabeis, de onde venho, nem para onde vou.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς κατὰ τὴν σάρκα κρίνετε, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω οὐδένα.

controles.web: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
controles.kjv: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
controles.livre: Vós julgais segundo a carne, eu não julgo a ninguém.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν κρίνω δὲ ἐγώ, ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ ἀληθινή ἐστιν, ὅτι μόνος οὐκ εἰμί, ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πέμψας με.

controles.web: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
controles.kjv: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
controles.livre: E se eu também julgo, meu juízo é verdadeiro; porque não sou eu só, mas eu, e o Pai que me enviou.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ δὲ τῷ ὑμετέρῳ γέγραπται ὅτι δύο ἀνθρώπων ἡ μαρτυρία ἀληθής ἐστιν.

controles.web: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
controles.kjv: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
controles.livre: E também em vossa Lei está escrito que o testemunho de duas pessoas é verdadeiro.

versos.grego: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, καὶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὁ πέμψας με Πατήρ.

controles.web: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
controles.kjv: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
controles.livre: Eu sou o que testemunho de mim mesmo; e também de mim testemunha o Pai, que me enviou.

versos.grego: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ Πατήρ σου; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Οὔτε ἐμὲ οἴδατε οὔτε τὸν Πατέρα μου· εἰ ἐμὲ ᾔδειτε, καὶ τὸν Πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε.

controles.web: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?”   Jesus answered, “You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
controles.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe pois: Onde está teu Pai? Respondeu Jesus: Nem a mim me conheceis, nem a meu Pai; se vós a mim conhecêsseis, também conheceríeis a meu Pai.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ γαζοφυλακίῳ διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ· καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπίασεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
controles.kjv: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
controles.livre: Estas palavras falou Jesus junto à arca do tesouro, ensinando no Templo; e ninguém o prendeu, porque sua hora ainda não era chegada.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν αὐτοῖς Ἐγὼ ὑπάγω καὶ ζητήσετέ με, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ὑμῶν ἀποθανεῖσθε· ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.

controles.web: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
controles.livre: Disse-lhes pois Jesus outra vez: Eu me vou, e me buscareis, e morrereis em vosso pecado; para onde eu vou vós não podeis vir.

versos.grego: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Μήτι ἀποκτενεῖ ἑαυτὸν, ὅτι λέγει Ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;

controles.web: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, that he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
controles.kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
controles.livre: Diziam, pois, os Judeus: Ele, por acaso, matará a si mesmo? Pois diz: Para onde eu vou vós não podeis vir.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ὑμεῖς ἐκ τῶν κάτω ἐστέ, ἐγὼ ἐκ τῶν ἄνω εἰμί· ὑμεῖς ἐκ τούτου τοῦ κόσμου ἐστέ, ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου.

controles.web: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
controles.livre: E ele lhes dizia: Vós sois de baixo, eu sou de cima; vós sois deste mundo, eu não sou deste mundo.

versos.grego: εἶπον οὖν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν· ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ πιστεύσητε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν.

controles.web: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I amhe, you will die in your sins.”
controles.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
controles.livre: Por isso eu vos disse, que morrereis em vossos pecados; porque se não credes que eu sou, morrereis em vossos pecados.

versos.grego: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ Σὺ τίς εἶ; εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τὴν ἀρχὴν ὅ τι καὶ λαλῶ ὑμῖν;

controles.web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?”   Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.
controles.kjv: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe pois: Quem és tu? Jesus lhes disse: Sou o mesmo que desde o princípio tenho vos dito.

versos.grego: πολλὰ ἔχω περὶ ὑμῶν λαλεῖν καὶ κρίνειν· ἀλλ’ ὁ πέμψας με ἀληθής ἐστιν, κἀγὼ ἃ ἤκουσα παρ’ αὐτοῦ, ταῦτα λαλῶ εἰς τὸν κόσμον.

controles.web: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
controles.kjv: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
controles.livre: Muitas coisas tenho que dizer e julgar de vós; mas verdadeiro é aquele que me enviou; e eu, o que dele tenho ouvido, isso falo ao mundo.

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι τὸν Πατέρα αὐτοῖς ἔλεγεν.

controles.web: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
controles.kjv: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
controles.livre: Mas não entenderam que ele estava lhes falando do Pai.

versos.grego: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὅταν ὑψώσητε τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, τότε γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ ποιῶ οὐδέν, ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἐδίδαξέν με ὁ Πατὴρ, ταῦτα λαλῶ.

controles.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
controles.livre: Jesus, então, lhes disse: Quando levantardes ao Filho do homem, então entendereis que eu sou, e que nada faço de mim mesmo; mas isto digo, como meu Pai me ensinou.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν· οὐκ ἀφῆκέν με μόνον, ὅτι ἐγὼ τὰ ἀρεστὰ αὐτῷ ποιῶ πάντοτε.

controles.web: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
controles.kjv: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
controles.livre: E aquele que me enviou está comigo. O Pai não me tem deixado só, porque sempre faço o que lhe agrada.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν.

controles.web: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
controles.kjv: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
controles.livre: Falando ele estas coisas, muitos creram nele.

versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς πεπιστευκότας αὐτῷ Ἰουδαίους Ἐὰν ὑμεῖς μείνητε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῷ ἐμῷ, ἀληθῶς μαθηταί μού ἐστε,

controles.web: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
controles.livre: Dizia, pois, Jesus aos judeus que criam nele: Se vós permanecerdes em minha palavra, verdadeiramente sereis meus discípulos.

versos.grego: καὶ γνώσεσθε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἐλευθερώσει ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
controles.kjv: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
controles.livre: E conhecereis a verdade, e a verdade vos libertará.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθησαν πρὸς αὐτόν Σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐσμεν, καὶ οὐδενὶ δεδουλεύκαμεν πώποτε· πῶς σὺ λέγεις ὅτι Ἐλεύθεροι γενήσεσθε;

controles.web: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s seed, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
controles.kjv: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
controles.livre: Responderam-lhe: Somos descendência  de Abraão, e nunca servimos a ninguém; como, pois , dizes: Sereis livres?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν δοῦλός ἐστιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας.

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
controles.kjv: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
controles.livre: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que todo aquele que comete pecado é servo do pecado.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ δοῦλος οὐ μένει ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· ὁ υἱὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

controles.web: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
controles.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
controles.livre: E o servo não fica em casa para sempre; o Filho fica para sempre.

versos.grego: ἐὰν οὖν ὁ Υἱὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλευθερώσῃ, ὄντως ἐλεύθεροι ἔσεσθε.

controles.web: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
controles.kjv: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
controles.livre: Portanto, se o Filho vos libertar, verdadeiramente sereis livres.

versos.grego: οἶδα ὅτι σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐστε· ἀλλὰ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ὅτι ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν.

controles.web: I know that you are Abraham’s seed, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
controles.kjv: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
controles.livre: Bem sei que sois descendência  de Abraão; porém procurais matar-me, porque minha palavra não encontra lugar em vós.

versos.grego: ἃ ἐγὼ ἑώρακα παρὰ τῷ Πατρὶ λαλῶ· καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν ἃ ἠκούσατε παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ποιεῖτε.

controles.web: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
controles.kjv: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
controles.livre: Eu, o que vi junto a meu Pai, isso falo; e vós, o que também vistes junto a vosso pai isso fazeis.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ ἐστιν. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ τέκνα τοῦ Ἀβραάμ ἐστε, τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ ποιεῖτε·

controles.web: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.”   Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
controles.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
controles.livre: Responderam, e lhe disseram: Nosso pai é Abraão. Disse-lhes Jesus: Se fôsseis filhos de Abraão, faríeis as obras de Abraão.

versos.grego: νῦν δὲ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ἄνθρωπον ὃς τὴν ἀλήθειαν ὑμῖν λελάληκα, ἣν ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ· τοῦτο Ἀβραὰμ οὐκ ἐποίησεν.

controles.web: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
controles.kjv: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
controles.livre: Porém agora procurais matar a mim, o homem que tenho vos falado a verdade que de Deus tenho ouvido; Abraão não fez isto.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν. εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἡμεῖς ἐκ πορνείας οὐκ ἐγεννήθημεν, ἕνα Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Θεόν.

controles.web: You do the works of your father.”   They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”
controles.kjv: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
controles.livre: Vós fazeis as obras de vosso pai.Disseram-lhe pois: Nós não somos nascidos de pecado sexual; nós temos um Pai: Deus.

versos.grego: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἰ ὁ Θεὸς Πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἦν, ἠγαπᾶτε ἂν ἐμέ· ἐγὼ γὰρ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἥκω· οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλ’ ἐκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.

controles.web: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
controles.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
controles.livre: Disse-lhes pois Jesus: Se Deus fosse vosso Pai, verdadeiramente me amaríeis; porque eu saí e venho de Deus; pois não vim de mim mesmo, porém ele me enviou.

versos.grego: διὰ τί τὴν λαλιὰν τὴν ἐμὴν οὐ γινώσκετε; ὅτι οὐ δύνασθε ἀκούειν τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐμόν.

controles.web: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
controles.kjv: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
controles.livre: Por que não entendeis meu discurso? Porque não podeis ouvir minha palavra.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστὲ καὶ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν θέλετε ποιεῖν. ἐκεῖνος ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἦν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ οὐκ ἔστηκεν, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν αὐτῷ. ὅταν λαλῇ τὸ ψεῦδος, ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων λαλεῖ, ὅτι ψεύστης ἐστὶν καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and its father.
controles.kjv: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
controles.livre: Vós sois filhos de vosso pai, o Diabo, e quereis fazer os desejos de vosso pai; ele foi homicida desde o princípio, e não permaneceu na verdade, porque nele não há verdade; quando fala mentira, fala do seu próprio; porque é mentiroso, e pai da mentira .

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ ὅτι τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι.

controles.web: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
controles.kjv: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
controles.livre: Porém a mim, porque vos digo a verdade, não credes em mim.

versos.grego: τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐλέγχει με περὶ ἁμαρτίας; εἰ ἀλήθειαν λέγω, διὰ τί ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι;

controles.web: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
controles.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
controles.livre: Quem de vós me convence de pecado? E se digo a verdade, por que não credes em mim?

versos.grego: ὁ ὢν ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀκούει· διὰ τοῦτο ὑμεῖς οὐκ ἀκούετε, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ἐστέ.

controles.web: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
controles.kjv: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
controles.livre: Quem é de Deus, ouve as palavras de Deus; portanto vós não as ouvis porque não sois de Deus.

versos.grego: Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Οὐ καλῶς λέγομεν ἡμεῖς ὅτι Σαμαρείτης εἶ σὺ καὶ δαιμόνιον ἔχεις;

controles.web: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
controles.kjv: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
controles.livre: Responderam, pois, os Judeus, e lhe disseram: Nós não dizemos com razão que és samaritano, e tens o demônio?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἐγὼ δαιμόνιον οὐκ ἔχω, ἀλλὰ τιμῶ τὸν Πατέρα μου, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀτιμάζετέ με.

controles.web: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
controles.kjv: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus: Eu não tenho demônio, antes honro a meu Pai; e vós me desonrais.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ ζητῶ τὴν δόξαν μου· ἔστιν ὁ ζητῶν καὶ κρίνων.

controles.web: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
controles.kjv: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
controles.livre: Mas eu não busco minha glória; há quem a busque, e julgue.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐάν τις τὸν ἐμὸν λόγον τηρήσῃ, θάνατον οὐ μὴ θεωρήσῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

controles.web: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
controles.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
controles.livre: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que se alguém guardar minha palavra, jamais verá a morte.

versos.grego: εἶπαν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Νῦν ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι δαιμόνιον ἔχεις. Ἀβραὰμ ἀπέθανεν καὶ οἱ προφῆται, καὶ σὺ λέγεις Ἐάν τις τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσῃ, οὐ μὴ γεύσηται θανάτου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

controles.web: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
controles.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe pois os Judeus: Agora conhecemos que tens o demônio. Abraão e os profetas morreram; e tu dizes: Se alguém guardar minha palavra, jamais experimentará a morte.

versos.grego: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ, ὅστις ἀπέθανεν; καὶ οἱ προφῆται ἀπέθανον· τίνα σεαυτὸν ποιεῖς;

controles.web: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
controles.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
controles.livre: És tu maior que nosso pai Abraão, que morreu? Os profetas também morreram. Quem tu dizes ser?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἐὰν ἐγὼ δοξάσω ἐμαυτόν, ἡ δόξα μου οὐδέν ἐστιν· ἔστιν ὁ Πατήρ μου ὁ δοξάζων με, ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐστιν,

controles.web: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
controles.kjv: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus: Se eu me glorifico a mim mesmo, minha glória é nada; meu Pai, o qual vós dizeis ser vosso Deus, ele é o que me glorifica.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώκατε αὐτόν, ἐγὼ δὲ οἶδα αὐτόν. κἂν εἴπω ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν, ἔσομαι ὅμοιος ὑμῖν ψεύστης· ἀλλὰ οἶδα αὐτὸν καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τηρῶ.

controles.web: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.
controles.kjv: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
controles.livre: E vós não o conheceis, mas eu o conheço; e se disser que não o conheço, serei mentiroso como vós; mas eu o conheço, e guardo sua palavra.

versos.grego: Ἀβραὰμ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἠγαλλιάσατο ἵνα ἴδῃ τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἐμήν, καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐχάρη.

controles.web: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.”
controles.kjv: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
controles.livre: Abraão, vosso pai, saltou de alegria por ver o meu dia; ele viu, e se alegrou.

versos.grego: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς αὐτόν Πεντήκοντα ἔτη οὔπω ἔχεις καὶ Ἀβραὰμ ἑώρακας;

controles.web: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?”
controles.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
controles.livre: Disseram-lhe, pois. os Judeus: Ainda não tens cinquenta anos, e viste a Abraão?

versos.grego: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, πρὶν Ἀβραὰμ γενέσθαι ἐγὼ εἰμί.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”
controles.kjv: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
controles.livre: Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que antes que Abraão fosse, eu sou.

versos.grego: ἦραν οὖν λίθους ἵνα βάλωσιν ἐπ’ αὐτόν· Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐκρύβη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ.

controles.web: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through their midst, and so passed by.
controles.kjv: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
controles.livre: Então tomaram pedras para atirarem nele. Mas Jesus se escondeu, e saiu do Templo.
